description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named `ImagesController` that handles HTTP requests for retrieving image content, such as store logos, content images, and product images, in a web application. It provides endpoints to fetch images based on store code, image type, product code, image name, and extension, utilizing services to load content and product images.
